description: India is the biggest market for the London-based ElevenLabs outside the United States. The voice AI company currently supports 14 Indian languages with plans to expand to 22 languages in the coming months.
body_lead: Voice AI startup ElevenLabs is working with the Karnataka government on an initiative that uses AI to help people who have lost the ability to speak communicate using a synthetic version of their voice. The initiative is part of a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS), formalised by ElevenLabs co-founder Mati Staniszewski and Karnataka Minister for Information Technology and Biotechnology Priyank Kharge at the company's first India Summit in Bengaluru on October 6.
